scenes.text: Imagine standing in a beautiful, fifty-mile strip of Yellowstone National Park where you could technically get away with any crime.
It sounds like a movie plot, but a bizarre constitutional loophole actually makes this place a real-life dead zone for the law.
Since nobody lives in this uninhabited Idaho strip, a legal jury cannot actually be formed to prosecute you.
Would you ever visit this place, or should you follow for more mysteries?
